title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：satellite　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 satellite 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the operator ① launched the satellite that no trainee in the station would have recorded, and he said the launching was the whole of the shift. The ② satellite, meaning the orbiter itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; a satellite, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ satellite in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ satellite at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A satellite, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the operator said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the satellite was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the orbiter. The ⑥ satellite, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; satellite, he said, is either something you launch or the only word that means both an orbiter and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ satellite had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ satellite of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of recording; satellite, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ satellite I remember is the orbiter recorded in the log, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ satellite, my mother said in 1968, is the only orbiter that improves by being recorded; every satellite, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like an orbiter. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 卫星（指机房里每一颗旁边的那一颗）
B. n. 卫星（指那颗卫星本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：launch the satellite 发射这一颗卫星
D. n. 卫星（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 卫星之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的卫星之事）
F. n. 卫星（指运行日志里写到、被记载的那一颗）
G. n. 卫星、联通（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联通（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: launched the satellite that no trainee in the station would have recorded
The satellite, meaning the orbiter itself and not the switch
the satellite at the far screen
the satellite was the whole of the matter
the satellite had become a line in a log
The satellite of the whole thing
A satellite, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: launch the satellite 意为“发射这一颗卫星”，1959 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯记载的一颗卫星做了一遍。
satellite 意为“卫星”，指那颗卫星本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记载。
satellite 意为“卫星”，指机房里每一颗旁边的那一颗，每一颗旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
satellite 意为“卫星”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
satellite 意为“卫星、联通”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这颗联通就是那件事的全部。
satellite 意为“联通”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那颗卫星，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
satellite 意为“卫星”，指运行日志里写到、被记载的那一颗，到 1964 年这一颗成了运行日志里的一行。
satellite 意为“卫星之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的卫星之事是一处机房和三个班次的记载。
satellite 意为“卫星”，我记得的是运行日志里记载过的那一颗，1966 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一颗。
satellite 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，卫星是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的卫星。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年那位操作员发射了机房里没有一位实习生肯记载的一颗卫星，他说这一遍才是那个班次的全部。（launch the satellite）
那颗卫星，指的是那颗卫星本身而不是小小的开关，经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记载。（satellite）
那处机房里每一颗卫星旁边都有同一个小小的开关。（satellite）
最远那块屏幕那颗卫星，指的是他们留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（satellite）
叔叔说这颗联通就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那颗卫星。（satellite）
1968 年母亲说，卫星是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的卫星。（satellite）

Every satellite in that station had the same short switch beside it.
The satellite at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the satellite was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the orbiter.
